answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one willow weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, someone who spins up 12 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 258 times the capital for one share. The glacier report makes public the merge explicitly at each vertex. A farm of 1141 identities would post 2769 proofs and burn roughly 34 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
